name: Sanguine Gift

passives.name: Patronage
passives.effects: Store 15% of post-mitigation damage dealt. Whenever the stored amount exceeds a value of 333, consume it to heal yourself and the nearest allied champion for that same amount. Stored damage is reset every round and between each phase in a round.

description:
80 Ability Power
20 Ability Haste
15% Heal and Shield Power

Patronage
Store 15% of the total damage you've dealt to enemies. Whenever this exceeds 333, consume it to heal yourself and your nearest ally for that amount.
